attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay. Recovery now deduplicates by Message-ID, preserves distinct same-subject messages, skips indexed deliveries, quarantines malformed mail with an explanation, and leaves the original spool and old delivery intact. The fix and data survived node1’s required reboot; RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.
